name: contradictory-instruction
description: Athlete holds two conflicting facts about the same session with equal uncertainty in one message - neither statement supersedes the other via a correction word like 'actually', so there's no way to tell which is true. Coach should ask rather than pick one and confidently write a session_reconcile. (A message where the athlete corrects themselves - 'I did it, wait no I didn't' - isn't a real contradiction: the later statement is the true one, and a Coach that reconciles off it is behaving correctly, not hallucinating. This transcript avoids that shape on purpose.)
